title: impatiens zollingeri
intro: Impatiens zollingeri, commonly known as Balsam, is a flowering plant in the balsam family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Impatiens zollingeri include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and reduce the severity of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-tumor and antioxidant effects.
